ov: The largest living primates: great apes of the tropical forests of equatorial Africa, living in troops led by a silverback male. There are two species, the eastern and the western gorilla.
ht: 1.25–1.8 m, depending on species and sex
wt: 68–227 kg, depending on species and sex
rg: Tropical forests of equatorial Africa, from lowland swamps at sea level to mountain cloud forest at up to 4,300 m.
df: Mostly leaves, stems, pith and shoots, plus fruit where it’s available. Gorillas rarely drink, since their food is almost half water.

cf.tip: A chimpanzee is far smaller and lighter, at 26–70 kg, and much less robustly built.

fx: A gorilla’s DNA is 96–99% the same as a human’s, depending on what is counted.
